display_name: Phase2 第二组：C 主干交叉对比提高 GPU 并发
description: Continue the fixed full matrix with increased GPU concurrency.
authorization: User authorized every B with C registration on native C source backbone and necessary auxiliary modules; ISSL stopped.

data.representation: eq1 first256 float64 raw -> original FP32 unit-RMS -> fixed practical residual/post_sync/no additional EQ
data.split_id: read exact existing K/N split IDs
data.source_target_overlap_policy: same source physical roles;target opens only B/C current support;query never fit

matrix.query: all_registered_complement; independent common-K intersection score also reported

permissions.regime: source-only A + current labeled old-B / new-C support
permissions.query_use: inductive per-record prediction only; truth after all fixed predictions
permissions.external_method_exception: original DA source-only L_s replay only where native B requires it
permissions.claim_scope: Exposed development project transplant preserving the C source backbone and native C core; Hu clean-L_s-only auxiliary, POSTER projection and other auxiliary-head changes differ from authors. Orthogonal may drop B bias; LoRa uses native kNN instead of the B decision. No external DURA.

checkpoint.initialization: Reuse C-source Group1 checkpoints and completed seed-bound Hu source auxiliaries; no source retraining.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: group1_source.load_source validates source contract and lineage
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: source-only Group1 matching source contract; actual load verified by launcher smoke
checkpoint.selection_rule: frozen Group1 source checkpoints; no target score selection or training of A

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0-6 at most 3 combined task workers/card, GPU7 at most 2; free >=6000 MiB; <=4 CPU scorers after all predictions frozen.
execution.stop_rule: Pause verified parent dispatcher only; let all owned workers finish; on any pre-transfer error resume exact parent; after transfer stop admission on technical failure, drain owned workers and retain outputs.

notes: Fixed 7 B × 3 C × 4 seeds × 483 capsules: 40572 jobs and 252252 prediction rows.
All 21 previously completed P01/MIX01/1-1 seed01 K5N20 rows and their natural/common scores are reused without recomputing.

Pilot B state was not retained. Its equality to the newly fitted B state for other N is unknown; reused rows mark B_fit_shared_across_N null and disclose provenance. Newly generated N share one new B fit per K.
Target predictions and scores are exposed-development assessment; results cannot change methods, budgets, selection or retry.
Hu source auxiliary TX/RX branch uses clean L_s, 200 epochs, frozen C backbone, explicit source RX and TX labels; differs from native Hu source recipe.
External B/C support/query remain raw without DURA; ISSL remains stopped and CSIL author binding unavailable.
Group2a failed r02/r03 partial predictions remain separate, preserved and not restarted by this owner.
CUDA MoPC hierarchy batches only elementwise subtraction/square; each layer reduction, accumulation order and objective remain unchanged.
Local source-shape model microbenchmark 20-epoch 5-class/5-shot warm median 4.29 s → 3.64 s on RTX5070Ti, two samples each, not N607 total throughput.

GPU model parameter and loss traces vary between repeated original runs due existing nondeterministic backward; fixed-tensor CUDA loss and gradients match bitwise; real source checkpoint no-query smoke repeats this check on N607.
All parent workers finish naturally; every closed parent prediction is linked unchanged and all 21 original pilot scores remain referenced.
Old parent is resumed on any error before ownership transfer; no additional model/source training or target-based selection.
After the global ALL_PREDICTIONS_FIXED barrier, use at most four long-lived CPU scorers; each calls the unchanged independent _score once per unscored job.
Reuse natural/common scores for the 21 fixed pilot rows; no query or truth enters any training or prediction process.
On scoring process or submission failure stop admission, drain in-flight tasks, record FAILED and retain outputs.
N607 measured isolated scorer module/process startup median 3.61s (5 sequential starts under shared CPU), not end-to-end scoring throughput.
Previously observed N607 same B/C/seed/scene/K5N20 LS old 17.92s vs optimized 18.08s on different pools and shared GPU, so no server-side MoPC speedup claim yet.
GPU concurrency increase only; scientific matrix, source checkpoints, prediction reuse and truth-last barrier unchanged. Actual throughput and shared GPU use are to be measured.
